Key Concepts

Main rule

The lesson explains the key rule or system idea behind Golf Rules.

The student needs to understand the correct idea before using English to explain it.

Useful language

Short clear sentences help the student talk about Golf Rules without getting lost.

Simple language makes technical topics teachable and easier to remember.

Check for understanding

The student should explain the idea, answer one question, and repair one mistake.

A technical review lesson should confirm real understanding, not only passive reading.

Topic to explanation

Golf Rules -> clear explanation -> correct answer

The lesson should move from the topic itself to a simple explanation and then to a clear answer.

Review to confidence

review -> teacher check -> student confidence

Review plus one direct check helps the student speak about the topic with more confidence.
